@bettina.kroll: I haven't set up the recurring digest. Scheduled jobs from this workspace deliver only to the local session, not back into Slack, so a job would not reliably post to #coastal-team on Mondays. I also don't want to post content on a schedule without a person checking it first.

I can post a "Coastal week ahead" digest from #coastal-team and #coastal-random whenever you ask me to, and I'll leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values) unless they're already posted in the channel. If you want it automated, the scheduling needs to go through Slack or whoever administers the workspace bot.
